source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
A psychic level 1 ability. During the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), when **selected to fight**, this unit may roll one D6 as its **psychic roll**, unless it is **battle-shocked**. If it does:

- A roll of 1 makes this unit battle-shocked.
- Its melee attacks gain **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)** and **[[PSYCHIC]](vsdata:weapon-ability/psychic)** for the rest of the phase.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 6 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

trigger.event: this unit is selected to fight

effect.durationBasis: Core Rules 01.02.02: the official text prints no duration, so the effect lasts only for the phase it was applied in.
